Hi Rebecca —

Thanks again for the warm intro yesterday. We're excited to get MedSphere into a short engagement week to validate connectivity, run the initial prompts, and align on success metrics. To keep things tight, proposed plan and asks below: 

Proposed session (pick one):
- Option A: Tue May 18, 10:00–11:30 PT (recommended)
- Option B: Wed May 19, 13:00–14:30 PT

Draft attendee roster (please confirm additions / alternates):
- Rebecca Torres — Program Lead (MedSphere)
- Lisa Chen — Data Ops (MedSphere) — suggested
- Mina Haddad — CS Lead (Redwood)
- Karthik Iyer — Solutions Engineer (Redwood)
- Marcus Lin — Implementation Engineer (Redwood)

Agenda (90m):
1) 10m — Intros & goals (Rebecca + Mina)
2) 20m — Network & security checklist (Marcus)
3) 30m — Live walkthrough: sample flows & reranking (Karthik)
4) 20m — Run-of-show for week: test cases, metrics, owner playbook (Mina)
5) 10m — Next steps & action items

Attachments: Redwood_Engage_Week_Deck.pdf (slides), EngageWeek_RunOfShow.xlsx (detailed slate).

Meeting link: will send as calendar invite after you confirm the date. Also asking for any SSO/proxy notes and an S3 temp bucket if you want us to push sample payloads for the smoke tests.

Please reply with your preferred option and any extra attendees to add.

Best,
